finding.comment: 'never expire' is qualified by 'mid-session', and the 24-hour expiry applies to refresh tokens — a different object; the statements are compatible, not contradictory

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/auth-tokens.md
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Auth tokens
+
+Session tokens never expire mid-session.
+
+## Rotation
+
+Refresh tokens expire after 24 hours and must be renewed through
+the refresh endpoint.
